model_name: Windows Memory Forensics Behavioral Analysis Rules

encoded_command.description: PowerShell command line contains encoded-command syntax.

execution_policy_bypass.description: PowerShell execution policy is bypassed for the process.

no_profile.description: PowerShell launches without loading the user profile.

discovery_commands.description: Multiple identity, network, or privilege discovery commands were observed.

unsigned_module.description: Unsigned module loaded into a process.

user_writable_module_path.description: Module was loaded from a user-writable directory.

unsigned_temp_dll.description: Unsigned DLL loaded from a user Temp directory.

external_connection_from_rundll32.description: rundll32.exe established an outbound connection to an external address.

external_connection_from_powershell.description: PowerShell established an outbound connection to an external address.

uncommon_destination_port.description: Process communicated over a higher-interest destination port.

attempted_internal_smb.description: Process attempted an internal SMB connection without evidence of a completed session.

private_rwx_region.description: Process contains private readable, writable, and executable memory.

private_executable_unbacked_region.description: Process contains private executable memory with no backing file.

confidence_language.HIGH: Multiple independent forensic artifacts converge on the same suspicious process chain and warrant high-priority investigation.
confidence_language.MODERATE: Several suspicious artifacts are present, but additional forensic evidence is required before stronger conclusions can be supported.
confidence_language.LOW: Observed artifacts provide limited evidence of suspicious behavior.

analyst_guardrails: Do not classify an unsigned DLL as malware without additional analysis.
Do not classify private executable memory as confirmed process injection without evidence establishing the injection mechanism.
Do not classify an outbound connection as command-and-control solely because the destination or port is unusual.
Do not classify a SYN_SENT SMB event as successful lateral movement.
Distinguish observed evidence from analyst hypotheses in all findings.
